name: print-social-creative-hands-craft-show-flyer-navy-with-painter-illustration
title: 'Creative Hands Craft Show' flyer in hot pink and navy with a flat illustration of a woman painting
whatItIs: A navy A5 flyer bordered in hot pink, with mint 'Date' and address details, a bold white 'CREATIVE HANDS CRAFT SHOW' headline, small star sparkles, and a flat illustration of a woman in overalls painting at an easel beside a vase, ruler and paint palette.
whatItMeans: Friendly and crafty; a warm illustrated scene makes a community event feel personal rather than corporate.
techniques: Frame a poster in a single bold contrasting border colour.
Illustrate the event's activity directly (a person crafting).
Scatter small sparkle stars for a light celebratory touch.

vocabulary.definition: A poster framed by a contrasting solid colour edge.
A small star shape used for light decorative emphasis.
